contract.calendar: Fixed UTC+8; only valid2026..2099 RTC observations publish a total. Runtime start/first valid time/new day/date rollback starts a zero baseline. Same-day clock revision or drift over2s drops the ambiguous interval and preserves earlier known total. Invalid-to-valid time starts a new baseline. No attribution of cross-day deltas.
contract.continuity: H-L-H native read after bank/XL/CTRL10 checks. uint16 modular difference only within a nondecreasing extended monotonic interval <=300000ms; delta bound ceil(elapsed_ms*26/1000)+32 rejects untrustworthy discontinuity rather than clipping it. uint32 total saturates. This is not step recognition or accuracy calibration and cannot detect all possible resets retaining configuration.
contract.metadata: Native source, version, sample monotonic time/UTC, local day, clock revision, raw count and coverage start; partial_day=true. Short shared critical-section copy. Getter rechecks current clock/day/revision/age before exposing total_valid.
contract.display: Only STEPS metric populated. Targets/hour masks and other metrics stay unknown. Main compares total/validity to refresh existing LVGL adapters. No layout, XML or semantic generated output change.
contract.schedule: Awake1s, screen off60s, shortened near midnight; screen and clock events request an immediate observation. Only prepare/read/cleanup sequences hold this service's IDLE request; healthy waits release it. Unconfirmed stop retains FAULT/IDLE until explicit recovery. Sensor runs autonomously between reads.
